english.title: Make a false statement re application under s.20 to be exempted from duty s.16(2)(b) and (3A)
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), in connection with an application under Section 20 of the Football Spectators Act 1989 to be exempted from any duty under section 16(2)(b) and (3A) of the said Act, made a statement which you knew to be false or misleading in a material particular, or recklessly made a statement which was false or misleading in a material particular in that **(..SPECIFY THE PARTICULAR..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 20(10)(a) and (11) of the Football Spectators Act 1989.

english.notes:
(i) This offence wording APPLIES ONLY to International Football Banning orders as introduced by the Football (Offences and Disorder) Act 1999 and will remain valid until the end of the expiry period for International Football Banning Orders. Although the issuing of International Football Banning Orders has now lapsed, it is feasible that the date for expiry of such an order could be 28/08/2010 and therefore this offence wording will be valid until that date.
(ii) For the similar offence in relation to Banning Orders introduced by the Football (Disorder Act) 2000 see H3472.
(iii) Now PNC recordable from 18/08/07 as per S.I. 2007/2121
